text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Constitutional Council accepted four appeals against the results of last year's parliamentary elections and ordered new elections for the four seats.
- Prime Minister Hariri said the Constitiutional Council's decisions strengthens the country's credibility.
- A pro-Syrian Amal Movement guerrilla launched a suicide attack by using a fishing boat against Israeli navy boat.
- Three bombs went off on the coastal road near port city of Tyre without causing casualties.
- The Lebanese government will ship back to Germany a total of 21 plastic waste containers out of 36 which were illegaly imported to Lebanon last August. The rest will be shipped within 14 days.
- Weekly treasury bill issue of May 15 raised 465 billion Lebanese pounds. The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of 171 billion pounds.
- President Hrawi said the solution for Lebanon's problems is by having equal rights for all citizens.
- Foreign Minister Bouez ended an official visit to Romania.
- Lebanon signed with Saudi Arabia a $2 million loan agreement for schools reconstruction.
